When emptying a shelf for maintenance, the storekeeper wants to create an internal transfer without typing each product: pick the source shelf and the system fills the transfer with everything currently stored there.

### Candidate 2: stock_move_location (OCA module, "Move Stock Location")
Direct dependencies: stock
Documentation:
# Move Stock Location

## SUMMARY
This module allows to move all stock in a stock location to an other one.

## DESCRIPTION
This module allows to move entire location of products from one place to
another and move only selected quantities.

## USAGE
- A new menu item Operations \> Move from location... opens a wizard where 2 locations
  can be specified.
- Select origin and destination locations and press "IMMEDIATE TRANSFER" or "PLANNED
  TRANSFER"
- Those lines can be edited. Move quantity can't be more than a max available quantity
- Move doesn't care about the reservations and will move stuff anyway
- If during your operation with the wizard the real quantity will change it will move
  only the available quantity at the button press
- Products will be moved and a form view of picking that did that will show up
- If "PLANNED TRANSFER" is used - the picking won't be validated automatically

If you want to transfer a full quant:

- Go to Inventory \> Products \> Products and click "On hand" smart button or Inventory
  \> Reporting \> Inventory, the quants view will be opened.
- Select the quantities which you want move to another location

If you go to the Inventory Dashboard you can see the button "Move from location" in each
of the picking types (only applicable to internal and outgoing transfers). Press it and
you will be directed to the wizard.

To enable this option, check "Show Move On Hand Stock" in the Picking Type
configuration.

If you want transfer everything from [...]
Business functions (knowledge graph):
- Fill draft picking with products from source location: Populates a draft picking with stock move lines for all available products in the specified source location.
- Move specific stock quants: Enables users to select specific quants from the product on-hand or inventory reporting views and transfer them to a designated location.
- Move stock between locations via wizard: Transfers entire stock or selected product quantities from an origin location to a destination location using a specialized wizard, supporting both immediate and planned transfers.
Models (relation of the module to the model; fields the module adds):
- wiz.stock.move.location.line (Wizard move location line) [ADDS_FIELD, DEFINES]; adds custom, destination_location_id, lot_id, max_quantity, move_location_wizard_id, move_quantity, origin_location_id, owner_id ...
- stock.picking (Transfer) [EXTENDS]
- wiz.stock.move.location (Wizard move location) [ADDS_FIELD, DEFINES]; adds apply_putaway_strategy, company_id, destination_location_disable, destination_location_id, edit_locations, exclude_reserved_qty, origin_location_disable, origin_location_id ...
- stock.move (Stock Move) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds location_move
- stock.picking.type (Picking Type) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds show_move_onhand

### Candidate 3: stock_request (OCA module, "Stock Request")
Direct dependencies: stock
Documentation:
# Stock Request

## SUMMARY
Internal request for stock

## DESCRIPTION
This module was written to allow users to request products that are
frequently stocked by the company, to be transferred to their chosen
location.

## USAGE
\## Creation

- Go to 'Stock Requests / Stock Requests' and create a new Request.
- Indicate a product, quantity and location.
- Press 'Confirm'.

Upon confirmation the request will be evaluated using the procurement
rules for the selected location.

In case that transfers are created, the user will be able to access to
them from the button 'Transfers' available in the Stock Request.

\## Cancel

When the user cancels a Stock Request, the related pending stock moves
will be also cancelled.

## CONFIGURE
To configure this module:

- Go to Stock Requests \> Settings

Users should be assigned to the groups 'Stock Request / User' or 'Stock
Request / Manager'.

\## Group Stock Request / User

- Can see her/his own Stock Requests, and others that she/he's been
  granted permission to follow.
- Can create/update only her/his Stock Requests.

\## Group Stock Request / Manager

- Can fully manage all Stock Requests
Business functions (knowledge graph):
- Cancel stock requests and related moves: Cancels any related pending stock moves automatically when a stock request is cancelled by the user.
- Control stock request access permissions: Controls access levels to stock requests using user and manager security groups.
- Request internal product transfers: Allows users to create and confirm requests for products frequently stocked by the company to be transferred to a specific location, triggering procurement rules and linking any generated stock transfers.
Models (relation of the module to the model; fields the module adds):
- stock.location (Inventory Locations) [EXTENDS]
- stock.request.order (Stock Request Order) [ADDS_FIELD, DEFINES]; adds allow_virtual_location, company_id, expected_date, has_message, location_id, move_ids, my_activity_date_deadline, name ...
- stock.request (Stock Request) [ADDS_FIELD, DEFINES]; adds allocation_ids, allow_virtual_location, allowed_uom_categ_id, company_id, expected_date, has_message, location_id, move_ids ...
- stock.request.abstract (Stock Request Template) [ADDS_FIELD, DEFINES]; adds allow_virtual_location, allowed_uom_categ_id, company_id, has_message, location_id, my_activity_date_deadline, name, procurement_group_id ...
- stock.picking (Transfer) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds stock_request_count, stock_request_ids
- res.config.settings (Config Settings) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds group_stock_request_order, module_stock_request_analytic, module_stock_request_kanban, module_stock_request_mrp, module_stock_request_purchase, module_stock_request_submit, stock_request_allow_virtual_loc, stock_request_check_available_first
- stock.route (Inventory Routes) [EXTENDS]
- stock.warehouse (Warehouse) [EXTENDS]
- stock.move (Stock Move) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds allocation_ids, stock_request_ids
- res.company (Companies) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds stock_request_allow_virtual_loc, stock_request_check_available_first
- stock.request.allocation (Stock Request Allocation) [ADDS_FIELD, DEFINES]; adds allocated_product_qty, company_id, open_product_qty, product_id, product_uom_id, requested_product_qty, requested_product_uom_qty, stock_move_id ...
- stock.move.line (Product Moves (Stock Move Line)) [EXTENDS]
- procurement.group (Procurement Group) [EXTENDS]
- stock.rule (Stock Rule) [EXTENDS]
